{{Quote|Peace onto you, friend. I bear word from the Masters of the temple.|Aven|<ref name="The Arm" />}}
'''Aven'''<ref name="The Arm" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who resided on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Learning [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] late in their life, the [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Aven had green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] as well as the olive-colored skin and facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]<ref name="The Arm" /> typical of their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Aven was employed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] on Tython to bring word to new arrivals of the teaching resources available to them. When a [[Hero of Tython|young initiate]]<ref name="The Arm" />&mdash;the future Hero of Tython<ref name="TORE" />&mdash;arrived at the Temple<ref name="The Arm" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Arm That Holds the Saber|Tython}} is part of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which in turn takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> Aven informed the Jedi that Master [[Muheeda]] would instruct the student in other skills and uses of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Arm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aven appears in<ref name="The Arm" /> the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tython, where they are located at the entrance to the Jedi Temple. As part of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "The Arm That Holds the Saber," Aven instructs new players to seek out Master Muheeda as a tutorial on class skill trainers.<ref name="The Arm" />
